# Heal

Source: [4386](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4386); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Heal](../../api/actions/heal.md).

<a id="wiki-4386-n1"></a>

- Heal does not resurrect dead players; healing is capped by max health and may be modified by buffs/debuffs.

<a id="wiki-4386-n2"></a>

- Null healer gives nobody healing credit.
